Unconfirmed Iranian claims on 27 Nov: tankers hit mines north of Ghavam Island, at the entrance to Khasab port and east of the strait (latest claim about 00:00 Israel time, 28 Nov), two tankers taken back from US forces and warning shots at a US F-16 near Hengam.
